meta.description: Book a trusted mobile car wash and detailing service that comes to you. Interior and exterior cleaning at your home or office, on your schedule.

hero.kicker: Mobile car wash & detailing • Fort Wayne, IN
hero.h1: Car wash and detailing, at your doorstep.
hero.sub: Book a trusted mobile car wash or detailing service in minutes. We come fully equipped — you get a spotless, showroom-ready car without leaving home.

how.sub: From booking to a clean car, everything is built around your time.

steps.title: Book in the app
steps.body: Choose a service, add your vehicle, and pick a time. Get an instant flat-rate quote.

steps.title: We come to you
steps.body: A nearby vetted detailer is assigned. Track their arrival in real time.

about.intro: RayCarWash brings professional car care directly to your doorstep. We're transforming how people think about car maintenance — no more waiting in line at a wash bay or rearranging your schedule for a detailing appointment.
storyBody: We started RayCarWash because we experienced the same frustration as everyone else: car care always seemed to require too much time and too many compromises. Whether it was finding someone to watch the kids while you waited at a wash, or blocking out half a day for a detail, traditional car care simply didn't fit modern life.

Our solution was simple: bring the detailer to the car. By connecting clients with vetted, independent detailers who bring everything needed to the client's location, we've eliminated the friction from car care — making it as easy as ordering a ride.

values.title: Convenience first
values.body: Your time is valuable. We built our entire experience around fitting car care into your schedule, not the other way around.

values.title: Trust & safety

values.title: Quality without compromise
values.body: Professional-grade tools and products, delivered with the care you'd expect from seasoned experts.
